title: 自動制御
subtitle: Automatic Control
keywords: Feedback Control 2.Transfer Function 3.Laplace Conversion & Inversion 4.Transient & Frequency Responses 5.Stability
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn framework of feedback control theory involving "Mathematical Expression","Laplace Conversions","Block Diagrams","Transfer Functions" and furthermore (2) learn characteristics "Transfer Functions","Stability","Transient & Frequency Responses","Steady States".
advice: This is a basic course of Feedback Control. We will cover the following materials: 1. Basic concepts in feedback control: The Laplace inversion & the time functions, System elements and block diagram, Graphical representation by the frequency functions. Representation with elementary blocks. 5. Stability of linear control systems 2. The various elements of a control process: The concept of stability Proportional, integrating, differentiating, and Stability analysis using the Routh-Hurwitz criterion 1st-order-, 2nd-order-, & delay-time lag blocks. (matrices & determinants) 3. Transformation from time (t) to frequency (s) domains: The elementary blocks & the transfer functions, The Laplace transformation & the transfer functions, Examples of electric circuit systems. 4. Transfer characteristics of typical basic blocks: Specifications in the time domain (transient responses), Specifications in the frequency domain (frequency responses)
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of “Computer Engineering for Electrical Engineers” and “Electrical and Electronic Instrumentation”. Enough skill of mathematics (especially matrix / inverse matrix and determinant calculations). Basic knowledge of mathematics (the Laplace conversion & inversion and so on). How to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the elementary blocks and their basic characteristics.
Be able to explain the Laplace conversion and inversion.
Be able to explain the transfer functions and represent control systems with the transfer functions & block diag
Be able to perform basic designs of the feedback control systems using the transfer functions.
Be able to explain analytical stability criteria on linear control systems.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain more than six elementary blocks of a control process and their characteristics. (2) Perform the Laplace conversions & inversions for the transfer functions that play key roles in complicated control systems. (3) Express the transfer elements in the frequency (s) domain for some electric circuit models. (4) Calculate and characterize the transient and frequency responses of the transfer functions in the complicated control systems.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain some basic elements of a control process and their characteristics. (2) Perform the Laplace conversions & inversions for the elementary transfer functions using mathematical formulas. (3) Express the transfer functions of control systems in block diagrams. (4) Explain transient responses to noise signals and their stabilities, and analyze them using the Routh-Hurwitz criterion.

lessons.content: Course introduction and basic concepts of control systems such as "Automatic Control", "Feedback Control","Elementary Blocks", "Block Diagram" and so on.
The basic "Elements" of a control process: "Proportional", "Integral", "Differential", "1st-order-time","2nd-order-time" elements

Description of continuum systems in the time domains and transformation from time (t) to frequency (s) domains, including “the elementary blocks & the transfer functions” and “the Laplace transformation & the transfer functions”.
Test and review about contents learned in No.1 to 3 classes.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Test (1) and review Self-reflection

lessons.content: Basic connections of elementary blocks and equivalent block manipulations. Description of continuum systems in the time domains and transformation from time (t) to frequency (s) domains in electric circuit systems.
Transfer characteristics of typical basic blocks: Specifications in the time (t) domain (transient response).
Transformation from time (t) to frequency (s) domains: The elementary blocks & the transfer functions, The Laplace conversion & inversion, and summarize the transfer functions and the block diagrams
Test and review about contents learned in No.5 to 7 classes.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Test (2) and review Self-reflection

lessons.content: Stability of linear control systems, especially the concept of stability
Stability of linear control systems, especially mathematical formations (characteristic equations) using matrices and determinants
Stability of linear control systems, especially analysis using the Routh- Hurwitz criterion (matrices & determinants)
lessons.operation: Interactive lecture & practice on the basis of questions & proposals

lessons.content: Test and review about contents learned in No.9 to 11 classes.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Test (3) and review Self-reflection

lessons.content: Overall exercises for promoting total learning abilities.
lessons.operation: Interactive lecture & practice on the basis of questions & proposals

lessons.content: Comment on the exam, grade notification, and self-evaluation
